name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement to the open-source SDK or local node
title: "feature: "
---

Please search existing issues and start a discussion before building a large
change. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cogniumhq/skillsregistry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for this repository's scope.

## What are you trying to do?

Describe your use case and the current limitation.

## What would help?

Describe the behavior or interface you would like, with an example if useful.

## Alternatives

What have you tried or considered?

## Scope

Which SDK package or local node component would change? The hosted service is
maintained separately; requests for it belong in
[Discussions](https://github.com/cogniumhq/skillsregistry/discussions).
